bio.text: Jay Obernolte represents California's 23rd Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives.
He previously served in the California State Legislature for the 33rd Assembly District and as Mayor of Big Bear Lake.
He owns a video game development studio and holds a B.S. from Caltech, and lives in Big Bear Lake with his wife, Heather.
